description: Ansari Sugar Mills Limited is a Pakistani sugar producer incorporated on 9 July 1989 as a public limited company, with shares quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Its business is manufacturing white refined sugar from cane — buying, cultivating and crushing cane and disposing of the sugar to dealers, distributors and exporters — and its board appointed Khawaja Anver Majid in 2008 to run the mills and manage the company's affairs.
headOffice: CL 5/4, Club Street, Main Abdullah Haroon Road, Karachi 75350, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (ansarisugar.com.pk/en: incorporation on 9 July 1989 and PSX quotation; /en/page/company-profile/business for the sugar manufacturing activity and cane procurement; /en/page/company-profile/profile for the 2008 board resolution appointing Mr Anver Majid to run the mills; /en/page/governance/board-of-directors for Khawaja Anver Majid as CEO and executive director; /en/page/contact for the head office address), read 2026-10-17.
